description: This file defines a ReviewProvider class that manages review data, interacts with an API service, and notifies listeners about state changes. It is part of a Flutter app, providing review-related functionalities such as fetching and submitting reviews.

classes.name: ReviewProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier based class managing review data, fetching reviews from an API, submitting new reviews, and notifying UI components of data changes.

methods.name: ReviewProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with an API service instance.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest reviews from the API and updates internal state, notifying listeners.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits a new review through the API with provided details.
